name: Grasstoid
check: A living patch of grass. Nobody down here has touched it. Ever.

acts.label: Touch
acts.text: * You touched the grass. You feel less fluffy. FUR -10.

acts.label: Dinner
acts.text: * You ask Grasstoid for a healthy meal.

default: * Grasstoid invites you to touch grass.
* Smells like fresh dew and outdoor air.
* (You haven't been outside in a while. Neither has the grass, technically.)
lowHp: * Grasstoid is turning a little brown.
spareable: * Grasstoid has been touched. Peace has been achieved.
* Grasstoid is glowing. It is just sunlight, probably.

deathText: * Grasstoid dries up into loose lawn clippings.
